name: Community poll result
oneLiner: a glass community poll post turns in, the votes pour in and the bars race with the runner-up leading early, then the winner overtakes, flips green with a check, lifts with its percent while the rest dim and the footer turns to Final results
say: when the speaker says they asked their audience ('I ran a poll', 'you voted and the answer was...'): the bars race under the question and the winner flips green on the answer
